query: Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr has 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility in the cast state and a yield strength of 163–530 MPa at 1000 °C at strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1, but its poor oxygen resistance limits practical high-temperature use. What single intervention could overcome this limitation without sacrificing the alloy’s useful mechanical performance? Formulate one hypothesis specifying the intervention and mechanism, the predicted change relative to untreated cast HfNbTaTiZr, the relevant temperature, atmosphere, exposure time, and mechanical-loading boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a controlled falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: The application of a 5-μm thick Al2O3 ceramic coating via plasma spray deposition on the surface of equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr in the cast state will improve its oxygen resistance at high temperatures without sacrificing its mechanical performance.
generation.intervention: application of a 5-μm thick Al2O3 ceramic coating via plasma spray deposition
generation.conditions: temperature: 1000 °C, atmosphere: oxidizing, exposure time: 100 hours, mechanical-loading boundaries: strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1
generation.mechanism: formation of a protective oxide layer that prevents oxygen diffusion into the alloy
generation.predicted_outcome: a 30% reduction in oxidation-induced mass gain relative to untreated cast HfNbTaTiZr, with no significant change in yield strength (±10%)
generation.boundary: temperature: 1000 °C, atmosphere: oxidizing, exposure time: 100 hours, mechanical-loading boundaries: strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1
generation.uncertainty: coating thickness and uniformity may affect oxidation protection, and the coating may degrade over time or under mechanical loading

falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: if the coated alloy exhibits a mass gain greater than 20% relative to the untreated alloy, or a yield strength reduction greater than 15%, after exposure to 1000 °C in an oxidizing atmosphere for 100 hours, the hypothesis is falsified

frame.goal: improve oxygen resistance without sacrificing mechanical performance
constraints: without sacrificing the alloy's useful mechanical performance

families.principle: coating or surface treatment for oxidation protection
families.best_lever: application of a ceramic or metallic coating for oxidation protection

families.principle: influence of processing on oxide formation

families.best_lever: high-temperature annealing for oxide layer growth
